mapper.select: SELECT id, business_type, business_id, action, org_path, created_by FROM doc_audit_log WHERE business_type = #{businessType} ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO doc_audit_log (tenant_id, user_id, business_type, business_id, action, company_id, org_path, created_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{businessType}, #{businessId}, #{action}, #{companyId}, #{orgPath}, #{createdBy})

INSERT INTO doc_audit_log (tenant_id, user_id, business_type, business_id, document_no, action, before_value, after_value, source_ip, user_agent, trace_id, company_id, org_path, created_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{businessType}, #{businessId}, #{documentNo}, #{action}, #{beforeValue}::jsonb, #{afterValue}::jsonb, #{sourceIp}, #{userAgent}, #{traceId}, #{companyId}, #{orgPath}, #{createdBy})
